title: Your AI Isn't Stupid, It's Blind: Ran Aroussi on Memory
description:
Join Ran at AI DevCon NYC 2026 this November. Book your ticket with Ran's personal 30% off code RANA30:
https://tessl.co/a3a

Your AI isn't stupid, it's blind — and the fix is better context engineering, not more storage. Ran Aroussi, creator of yfinance, who now runs VarOps, has spent the last year building memory for company-scale AI agents. Get it right, and an unremarkable local model gets 99% of frontier quality.

What we cover:
– Why most agent memory is just raw text with a search box on top
– Context engineering for company-scale agents: distilling knowledge instead of storing more
– Tracking changes and keeping permissions intact once the source is gone
– How a local model reaches 99% of frontier quality
– What Ran is showing at AI DevCon in New York

Build your software factory, one workflow at a time, with Tessl:
https://tessl.co/la7

🔔 Subscribe for weekly videos on AI-native development

Where does context engineering break down for your agents — memory, retrieval, or permissions? Tell us in the comments.
